name: kafka-mcp-enterprise

tools.name: consume_messages
tools.description: Read messages from a topic (bounded by maxMessages / hard_max_records). Omit groupId for Direct Partition Assignment (no consumer-group join/rebalance); set groupId only for classic group consume. Read path; may register values into session taint. Sensitive topics may require `_approval_token`. Prefer produce_message to write; prefer describe_topic for metadata only.

maxMessages.description: Max records to return (clamped by hard_max_records)

fromBeginning.description: If true, read from earliest available offset

groupId.description: Optional; omit for Direct Partition Assignment (no rebalance)

tools.name: describe_cluster
tools.description: Return cluster identity and broker/controller metadata. Read-only; no side effects. Use for health/context before mutating topics. Prefer list_topics for the topic catalog and kafka://health for circuit-breaker status.

tools.name: describe_consumer_group
tools.description: Describe one consumer group (members, state, offsets) by `groupId`. Read-only. Use list_consumer_groups to discover ids. Does not change group membership.

tools.name: describe_topic
tools.description: Describe one topic by name: partitions, config, and metadata. Read-only. Requires `name`. Use list_topics first if the name is unknown. Does not create, alter, or delete the topic.

name.description: Exact topic name to describe (must exist)

tools.name: list_consumer_groups
tools.description: List consumer group ids. Read-only. Use describe_consumer_group for members, state, and offsets of one group. Does not join or leave groups.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List topic names known to the cluster. Read-only; no side effects. Use before describe_topic or produce/consume when you need the catalog. Prefer describe_topic for partitions/config of one topic.
